data.name: Obi
data.gender_notes: Obi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Obi is a name of Igbo origin from Nigeria, meaning power or strength. It has been used in various Christian contexts, representing the power and strength of God. The name Obi carries the meaning “Power, Strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Obi usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and protection
data.etymology: Obi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Obi has a rich cultural history in Igbo communities in Nigeria. It is often given to children as a sign of the strength and resilience they are expected to possess. Beyond being a personal name, Obi can also refer to the Obi of Onitsha, a traditional ruler and spiritual leader in the city of Onitsha.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Obi holds spiritual significance as a reminder of God's power and strength. It could be given as a name for a child to inspire them to live a strong and faithful Christian life. The name also references biblical figures like Obadiah, a humble and faithful servant of God, or Obadiah the prophet, who predicted God's judgment and their ultimate redemption.
